author: Electricks94
body:
#### PR description:

Since [#51554](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51554) it is possible to created nested SoABlocks. This means that a block of an SoABlocks is a block in itself. With this PR the static variable `blocksNumber` returned the number of blocks flattened. This means that it counts how many blocks each block has and returns the total sum. However, the same variable in the Descriptors of an SoABlock still returns the number non-flat. This means it just counts how many blocks an SoABlocks has without counting if a block has another sub-block. It is confusing that the same number has a different meaning/value

In this PR the two ways of counting the numbers of blocks are seperated creating a new static parameter called `blocksNumberFlat`, which gives the flattened total number of blocks and `blocksNumber` returning the non-flattened version.

#### PR validation:

Purly technical, tested locally running unit tests

FYI @felicepantaleo @mmarriot
title: Seperate blocksNumber and blocksNumberFlat
